notes.title: Soon to become FREE :)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, first off i wish you are all doing well and staying safe, it is with pleasure that i announce that both my games "The 111th Soul" and "Not in Heaven" will become free in a week or sooner, it is a gift to everyone in hope to give a tiny bit of a good time during this challenging period, and i deeply thank every person who bought and played the games while they had a price, your support means a lot to me, Thank you for every constructive review to my two first small games :) , i will strive to improve my future games with your support and incentive ;)

I wish you all the best 
Ricardo Pratas

notes.title: A deep thank you ;)
notes.notes:
I would like to thank all the people who have been playing and giving support and constructive criticism to me for almost a year now, as a solo developer it can be very hard to make a game, and my first attempt "The 111th soul" being a such a small game has been generally well received, even with its small flaws i am happy that most players liked it, i hope to announce my next game this month.

Best regards ;)

notes.title: New Update 1.1
notes.notes:
First of all i would like to thank everyone for the support that i have been receiving, and having been listening to the all useful tips here comes the first Update 1.1.

Changes:

-Added Main Menu with the "Good ending" main theme
-Tweaked lightning in some scenes
-Performance tweaks and optimization
-Minor sound changes
-After the "Evil ending" the game now loads autosave
-After the "Good ending" the game now returns to the main menu

Best Regards and a Happy 2018 :)

notes.title: 1 Day left
notes.notes:
As a solo developer i am proud to anounce that The 111th Soul is almost out for everyone to play, a short atmospheric supernatural story that i hope you can all enjoy, it is my first game and it will be at an accessible price of 1,99$ with a launch discount, i will appreciate all the constructive criticism and support to improve my future projects.

My best regards
Ricardo Pratas
